role_in_parent: Isolates the hard monotonicity content as a single combinatorial lemma, deliberately avoiding the previously rejected false explicit increment maps.
statement_nl: Let m be an integer with m >= 2 and let g be an integer with g >= 0. Define K_{m,g} to be the set of all tuples x = (x_1,...,x_{m-1}) of positive integers such that for all i,j in {1,...,m-1}, if i + j < m then x_i + x_j >= x_{i+j}, and if i + j > m then x_i + x_j + 1 >= x_{i+j-m}, and such that x_1 + ... + x_{m-1} = g. Define K_{m,g+1} to be the set of all tuples y = (y_1,...,y_{m-1}) of positive integers such that for all i,j in {1,...,m-1}, if i + j < m then y_i + y_j >= y_{i+j}, and if i + j > m then y_i + y_j + 1 >= y_{i+j-m}, and such that y_1 + ... + y_{m-1} = g + 1. Then there exists an injective function J_{m,g} from K_{m,g} to K_{m,g+1}.

domain_restrictions: K_{m,g} consists only of tuples x = (x_1,...,x_{m-1}) with each x_k ∈ Z_{>0}
For all i,j ∈ {1,...,m-1}: if i + j < m then x_i + x_j >= x_{i+j}; if i + j > m then x_i + x_j + 1 >= x_{i+j-m}. (No condition specified when i + j = m.)
K_{m,g+1} consists only of tuples y = (y_1,...,y_{m-1}) with each y_k ∈ Z_{>0}
For all i,j ∈ {1,...,m-1}: if i + j < m then y_i + y_j >= y_{i+j}; if i + j > m then y_i + y_j + 1 >= y_{i+j-m}. (No condition specified when i + j = m.)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For every integers m,g with m >= 2 and g >= 0, there exists an injective function J_{m,g}: K_{m,g} → K_{m,g+1}, where K_{m,g} (resp. K_{m,g+1}) is the set of all (m-1)-tuples of positive integers satisfying the specified implication-based inequalities for all i,j ∈ {1,...,m-1} (with no inequality required when i+j=m) and the sum constraint equaling g (resp. g+1).
